entities.summary: Treaty of Peace, a significant document in the history of United Arab Emirates (1820–1892). Part of Trucial States and British Treaties. Shaped Perpetual Maritime Truce — the 'Trucial States' name originates and Exclusive Agreements — each Trucial State becomes a British protectorate.
